title: MaleTheme Duo #002 · 남 클래식 머슬·라이트 스모키·닌자 테마 / 남 맨즈 피지크·그래픽 블랙·산타 테마·무늬
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the long reflecting pool path in front of the Taj Mahal with pale marble paving, a waist-high ornamental rail and low steps, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Thai man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, light smoky eyeliner and glossy skin, smooth golden-tan skin, a confident smirk, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in countless fine micro braids, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long gold chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop, and on the other ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (an iron teardrop-shaped sinker, a bronze miniature anvil, a lead ship's anchor, a silver round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked platinum necklaces. Extremely long almond nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a black ninja headband with a polished steel plate across his forehead, black fingerless wrist wraps, and a minimal black T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him tied with a red sash at the hip, his chest and stomach bare.
LEFT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme red platform high-heel mules, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Senegalese man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty-boy idol face with flawless smooth skin, large clear eyes, a slim jaw and soft full lips, clean-shaven, sharp black graphic eyeliner with matte nude lips and defined contour, deep blue-black skin with a smooth sheen, a relaxed easygoing look with a faint smile, natural soft black hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a copper cube-shaped block, a copper pyramid-shaped lump, a bronze chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a gold small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three mixed-metal hair ornaments. RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily tall and large man, far beyond any real person, with a men's physique build. Enormously broad shoulders with round capped deltoids, a wide upper chest tapering sharply to a very narrow waist in a dramatic V-taper, a lean sharply defined six-pack abdomen with visible obliques, thick strong arms, and long lean athletic legs that are muscular but not bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a red velvet Santa hat with a white fur trim and pom-pom, white fur cuffs on both wrists, and a minimal red leopard-print velvet with white leopard-print fur trim T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
RIGHT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue chelsea boots with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
